description: 🆕 Resolves the complete Base identity behind an address or Basename: resolved address, avatar, description, website and social handles (X/Twitter, GitHub, Farcaster, Discord) read from Base's L2 Resolver text records. Lets an agent turn a counterparty address into a real profile — beyond just the name. Complements address-trust (verification) with the human context.
